recommendedActions: Ascertain exact physical coordinates of victim.
Alert nearest PoA Special Cell / PCR quick response unit.
Provide continuous calming voice reassurance to caller.
assessments.counselingResponse: Hum aapki awaz sun rahe hain. Aap akele nahi hain, NHAA 14566 helpline aapki puri madad karegi. Kripya surakshit sthan par rahein, hamari team active ho chuki hai.
